Plague was a key factor in the waning of Antiquity and the beginning
of the Middle Ages.

text: Eight centuries before the Black Death, a pan- demic of plague engulfed the lands surrounding the Mediterranean Sea and eventually extended as far east as Persia and as far north as the British Isles.
